title: Enable Vaporize Xcode app test execution
description: The approved `vaporize test xcode --artifact app` route rejects a declared Xcode project and scheme with `test mode currently supports SwiftPM package tests only; use --artifact cli.` This prevents app-target TTD and Launch Review core tests from receiving an approved Xcode test receipt.
acceptanceCriteria: Vaporize accepts a macOS app Xcode project or workspace, scheme, and destination in test mode.
The command emits a typed test receipt distinguishing project load, build, test execution, and install/run state.
The app test route does not fall back to direct xcodebuild instructions or claim an installed app, release, or human approval.
A Launch Review fixture can execute its Xcode unit-test target through the route.
